segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Thanks for calling support, this is Maya. Can I get your company name and the email on your admin account?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yeah, so it's Northgate Planning, and my email is daniel.cho@northgateplanning.com.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Thanks, Daniel. I have your account pulled up. What can I help with today?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: We need to add five user seats for the operations team. We're currently at 42, and we'd like to go to 47 starting today if possible.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Sure, I can take care of that. You're on the Business plan billed annually, renewal on March 31, 2027. The prorated amount for five seats from today through renewal is $1,184.75 before tax. Does that work?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yep, that's fine. Can you use the payment method already on file?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Yes. I'll add the seats now and charge the card ending in 2846. One moment.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: All set. Your seat count is now 47, and I generated invoice 68134 for $1,184.75 plus applicable tax. The billing contact, invoices@northgateplanning.com, should receive it in a few minutes.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Great. Do I need to do anything else before inviting the new users?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: No, you're good. In the admin console, go to Users, then Invite users. The five additional seats are available immediately.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect, thanks for the quick help.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: You're welcome. Have a good rest of your day.
